svg.text: Rough directions: open book, crown pages, a hint of north. Small marks show 48, 32 and 16 px.
A crown folded from one page; the centre pleat points north.
A pen nib is the needle; its slit runs down into the spine.
Page edges stack up and harden into a crown.
One compass needle; its lower half is a crowned open book.
Three paper layers: two crowns rising behind an open book.
A bookmark carries the crown-book, with a needle for a jewel.
